Package de.labathome.trustconstr

Class IdentityVectorFunction

java.lang.Object
de.labathome.trustconstr.LinearVectorFunction
de.labathome.trustconstr.IdentityVectorFunction
All Implemented Interfaces:
VectorFunctionLike
public class IdentityVectorFunction extends LinearVectorFunction
Identity vector function f(x) = x (Jacobian I). Used by PreparedConstraint when a Bounds object is folded into the constraint set.

Counterpart to scipy's IdentityVectorFunction (scipy/optimize/_differentiable_functions.py:829).
